text:
Sam: Quick heads-up — PR #27610 is green on unit tests but integration is stuck in the queue. We have the rebase window at 18:00 UTC. Can someone own the rebase + quick follow-up so we don't miss the window?
Rachel: I can take the rebase and address the last review comments, but need CI to finish so I don't trigger another flake.
Jon: there's a flaky integration test (db-connection-timeout). I can try a manual rerun, but backlog is high.
ci-bot: queued rerun requested by @Jon for job=integration-linux (pr=27610). Position in queue: 12. ETA ~25-40m.
Rachel: if the rerun is >20m we might miss the smooth rebase slot. Can we plan a fallback?
Sam: fallback = split down to smaller PR (tiny schema tweak only) and canary that if integration keeps failing. Prefer to keep this PR together but don't block the release.
Priya: I can give final approval if the rebase is tiny and tests are green. If we hit the blackout window, we should defer. Tagging my OK criteria: rebase done, integration green, and no schema churn.
Jon: kicked a manual rerun: ```gh workflow run integration.yml -f pr=27610``` — will post updates.
ci-bot: manual workflow run started (run_id=87421). Status: running.
deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly deploy blackout starts in 2h 15m (18:15 UTC). Any merges after blackout will be deferred until the next window.
Rachel: noted. If it finishes in 10m I'll rebase and push. If not, I'll post a small split PR and ping for fast approval.
Sam: plan sounds good. Quick checklist: 1) Jon posts rerun status 2) Rachel rebases and updates PR 3) Priya approves if criteria met 4) Merge before 18:00 UTC, else defer to next slot.
Jon: run finished — integration passed on rerun.
Rachel: rebased and pushed. Requesting final eyes @Priya :thumbsup:.
Priya: looking now, quick lgtm on small schema change. Approving.
Sam: thanks — merging now to hit the rebase window. If anything goes sideways we revert and follow the canary fallback. :rocket:
